title: loop.sh run_agent hands the registry command to bash -c as a string
body: dev-agents.json promises exact token replacement with no shell, but run_agent builds the command string in dev_agent_command and then execs it inside bash -c '...; exec '"$cmd", so the {CWD} substitution is re-parsed by a shell: a repository path with a space truncates --cd and one containing ; or $(...) is command execution. Split the registry template into tokens BEFORE substitution, substitute per token, and pass an argv array (bash -c '...; exec "$@"' bash "${argv[@]}"); keep the string form only for the operator-supplied AI_AGENT_CMD. Found by the 2026-09 repository audit (docs/REPO_AUDIT_2026-09.md, finding 10) and confirmed against loop.sh on 2026-09-05.
